claims.text: Alternatives to mupirocin: ozenoxacin, retapamulin and fusidic acid; MSD notes the latter two are not available in the US
claims.quote: Mupirocin is most commonly used in the United States. Alternatives include ozenoxacin, retapamulin, and fusidic acid; the latter two are not available in the United States.

claims.text: Ozenoxacin 1% cream (topical quinolone, FDA 2017) was discontinued in the US in September 2025 and is expensive; an alternative if mupirocin and retapamulin resistance is a concern
claims.quote: Ozenoxacin 1% cream (available only as brand Xepi) is a topical quinolone approved by the US Food and Drug Administration in 2017 for the treatment of impetigo; however, it has been discontinued in the United States as of September 2025 and is expensive. It may be used as an alternative when there is concern for mupirocin and retapamulin resistance.
